settings.title: Clean hand, clean bag
settings.text: Built Birdie product pages should explain how each accessory feels, carries, clips, wipes, or stores in a real golf setup.

settings.title: Designed around bag behavior
settings.text: Every product should answer a simple question: where does it live on the bag, cart, desk, or practice station?

settings.title: Small details do the work
settings.text: Texture, color repeat, and attachment points are what make accessories feel intentional instead of random.

settings.question: Where should final material specs go?
settings.answer: Use this page and individual product descriptions for exact fabric, finish, size, care, and compatibility notes.

settings.question: Why add a materials page before launch?
settings.answer: It gives the store a credible place for product education as the catalog fills in.

settings.heading: Useful gear should feel obvious.
settings.subheading: A clean product education page for material notes, fit expectations, care details, and how each accessory belongs in the setup.
